notes.title: Update - Passive income & loans
notes.content:
[h2]New gameplay[/h2]
The new loan mechanic creates a new interesting way to play the game, taking a loan on a good deal can now create steady income. Because of the loans you start with less money and have to make smarter choices to make a profit.

[h2]New things:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added loan mechanic
[*]New building upgrade menu
[*]Added mouse controls
[/list]
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Decreased starting money
[*] Rebalanced rent income
[*] click on buildings in the list to jump to them
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.3 - Water
notes.content:
Added water to the game

- New map for each level
- Added water tile that cant be built on
- Added bridge tile that connects tiles across water
- Added boat and lighthouse as background objects

notes.title: Patch 1.2 - Balancing
notes.content:
- Added market demand for houses, apartments and skyscrapers
- Added market downturn event for each city effecting demand

- Fixed bonus stacking
- Increased price of buying new plot

notes.title: Patch 1.1 - UI Update
notes.content:
Updated UI to make it easier to read.

- added visual display for land/building price
- added character portraits and updated names

- resized most UI elements
- updated main menu UI level selection
